name: Tandem Fallschirmsprung Innsbruck
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The ultimate adrenaline rush: A tandem parachute jump from 4,000 meters above the Alpine city of Innsbruck. After exiting the plane, you experience a 50-second freefall at speeds up to 200 km/h before the parachute opens, allowing you to gently drift over Innsbruck’s rooftops. A moment you’ll never forget.
